§6Server Racks§f

§aOne block, four computers. Space-efficient computing.§f
A Server Rack holds up to 4 individual Servers. Each server is a card you slot in, with its own CPU, RAM, and upgrades.

§6What It Does§f:
The rack centralizes power intake and network connectivity. It also has a built-in switch (tier 1 by default) for routing packets between servers. Each rack consumes 50 energy per tick.

§9AE2 Gate§f:
Server Racks are a progression gate for Applied Energistics 2. The ME Controller recipe requires a Server Rack, a Capacitor, and an Engineering Processor in a NuclearCraft Assembler. No rack, no ME network.

§ePS:§f Servers come in tier 1, 2, and 3, just like regular cases. The rack itself is the block; servers are the items that go inside.
